entities.summary: Omasan Tokunbo Maxine Buwa is a Nigerian social worker, media commentator and beauty pageant titleholder who was crowned Most Beautiful Girl in Nigeria 1987. Throughout her career, she has worked as a model, television presenter, restaurateur, and actress, and most recently has appeared as a panellist on the TV show The Amazons.
